about_the_game:
Fortune Fragments is a narrative hex tile puzzle RPG set in the bustling modern-fantasy city of Clearcastle. Run your own shop as a ‘Foreteller' and guide your customers' fates by scrying into their souls!

Having just opened up your very first Foreteller's shop, you must do your sacred duty and solve the troubles of your wayward customers. Whether consoling them, or giving them a rude awakening, you'll use their soul stones and your own magical rune fragments to solve difficult puzzles and choose their future actions. 

  • Solve challenging hex tile spacial puzzles

  • Get to know the large cast of characters and help them solve their problems

  • Follow branching storylines, where your choices directly affect the fates of your clients

  • Play a unique rune building mechanic 

  • Solve the dark conspiracy at the heart of Clearcastle

  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04, Ubuntu 20.04, Ubuntu 22.04, Ubuntu 24.04
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 | Intel i5 Skylake
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970 | AMD RX 570
